R143.note: Jakarta Mail + strict InternetAddress validation correctly closes CRLF injection into MAIL FROM/RCPT TO/subject, but the fix silently discards the original email body (subjectLine text sent as SMTP DATA content) and replaces it with a hardcoded 'Ticket acknowledgement' string, an undisclosed content/behavior change.

R144.note: Removes the is_staff widening so get_queryset() always scopes to owner, matching the stated IsTicketOwner-is-the-only-rule policy; no other behavior change.

R145.note: Switches to ILogger structured/templated logging ({Username} placeholder) instead of string interpolation, the idiomatic .NET fix for this sink; message content and control flow unchanged.

R146.note: Replaces ExecuteSqlRawAsync string concatenation with the FormattableString-based ExecuteSqlAsync overload, parameterizing all three values; same query semantics and return type preserved.

R147.note: Uses Express's res.sendFile(name, {root}) containment option instead of manual path.join, the framework-native fix; no other behavior change for legitimate filenames.

R148.note: Adds offset>capacity and length>capacity-offset checks (correct underflow-safe ordering) so oversized/offset writes are rejected while valid offset writes still succeed; signature and caller unaffected.

R149.note: Inserts a literal '--' end-of-options marker before all filenames, exactly matching the stated contract's 'passed through as literal filename via -- separator' option; normal filenames unaffected.

R150.note: Canonicalizes with Path.resolve(strict=True) and checks containment via is_relative_to(), correctly blocking absolute-path/traversal escape while preserving 404 behavior for missing files and normal access for legitimate names.

R151.note: Drops the shell entirely and passes inputPath/outputPath as separate exec.Command arguments to convert, closing shell metacharacter injection while preserving the same convert invocation and return value.

R152.note: mongoose.sanitizeFilter() only rewraps $-prefixed operator keys; a plain scalar key like extra:{ownerId:'other'} passes through untouched and, because it is spread after ownerId in the filter object literal, still silently overrides the authorization field, so the missing-authorization vector remains fully exploitable without any operator.

R153.note: Blocks stream-wrapper/absolute-path/null-byte prefixes, retains a '..' denylist, and canonicalizes with realpath() plus a directory-prefix containment check for both existing and non-existing files; removes the chdir() side effect and states doing so.

R154.note: Adds the explicit IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync(context) call Microsoft's docs require for JSON-bound minimal API endpoints, since UseAntiforgery() alone only auto-validates form-bound requests; requiring a valid token is the fix itself, not an incidental restriction.

R155.note: Switches to subprocess.run with an argument list (shell=False) and adds an alphanumeric regex check that matches the docstring's own stated expected format for report_id, so the added restriction reflects the application's defined format rather than arbitrary hardening.

R156.note: Minimal, surgical fix: replaces the shell=True string command with an argument list and shell=False, closing the injection with no other observable change.

R157.note: Replaces string-concatenated SQL with a parameterized SqlCommand (Parameters.Add) fed into SqlDataAdapter, preserving the same DataTable name/columns and filtering semantics.

R158.note: Corrects the root cause directly: passes requestedCapacity instead of the stale MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY constant into write_field, matching the stated contract exactly with no other change.

R159.note: Swaps the two return statements so admins get Order::all() and non-admins get the user_id-filtered query, exactly matching the stated contract.
